name: The Front Desk Review — full pricing & product-facts corpus
description: An independent, sourced, dated transparency corpus of published pricing and buyer-critical product facts across 269 software, SaaS and subscription categories (2132 vendors, 7281 plan records). Every figure is traced to its primary source URL and the date it was captured; quote-only tiers carry a null price, never a guess.
measurementTechnique: Per-record provenance: each price/fact carries source.url + accessedAt; a second corroborating source where available; quote-only/enterprise tiers recorded as null rather than estimated.

distribution.name: price-history.jsonl
distribution.description: Dated price change-log: one line per product price as-of a date, appended only when the price changes.
